rows: Las si-tu-tu ro-hang-ku ro au ma-no-got on
Ma-mu-ji De-ba-tang-ku, si-ja-ga ngo-lung-kon.
Ho di ha-bang-sa-Mi tong-tong naeng pu-ji-on-ku, hu-hut pa-sa-nga-pon-ku mar-hi-te A-nak-Mi

verses: Las situtu rohangku ro au manogot on
Mamuji Debatangku, sijaga ngolungkon.
Ho di habangsaMi tongtong naeng pujionku,
Huhut pasangaponku marhite AnakMi
Ai nasa parmaraan, sude na jorbut i,
Dao sian au na borngin binaen ni basaMi.
Nuaeng asi rohaM sai sesa ma dosangku,
Sude pambahenanku na sogo ni rohaM
Ramoti au Tuhanku, muse sadari on,
Na tau hamagoanku padao ma i tongtong.
Ingani rohangkon, pature ma langkangku,
Tamparhon ma marangku, ramoti hosangkon.
Tondingku, pamatangku, rap dohot rohangkon,
Ro di sude donganku, na di portibi on,
Sai sahat ma tu Ho, ramoti ma nasida;
Ai na di au luhutna na nilehonMu do.
Paian suruanMu tongtong di lambungkon,
Ai ingkon ramotanMu do tondingki tongtong;
Dibaen pangonggop ni sibolis di rohangku,
Anggiat aloonku mambahen dosa i.
Marguru tu Tuhanku ma au di sasude;
Ditogu Debatangku ma au tu na ture,
Sai pasupasu ma ulaon ni tanganku,
Sude sibahenonku, o Tuhan Debata!
Antong hudok ma amen, ndang ganggu rohangki!
Tuhanku mangalehon na hupangido i.
Na lao ma au nuaeng mangula ulaonku;
Ibana do donganku na sonang au dibaen
title: Las situtu rohangku
status: Lirik dicek · 24/28 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Ai na-sa par-ma-ra-an, su-de na jor-but i,
Dao si-an au na bor-ngin bi-naen ni ba-sa-Mi.
Nu-aeng a-si ro-haM sai se-sa ma do-sang-ku, Su-de pam-ba-he-nan-ku na so-go ni ro-haM
Ra-mo-ti au Tu-han-ku, mu-se sa-da-ri on,
Na tau ha-ma-goan-ku pa-da-o ma i tong-tong.
I-nga-ni ro-hang-kon, pa-tu-re ma lang-kang-ku, Tam-par-hon ma ma-rang-ku, ra-mo-ti ho-sang-kon.
Ton-ding-ku, pa-ma-tang-ku, rap do-hot ro-hang-kon,
Ro di su-de do-ngan-ku, na di por-ti-bi on,
Sai sa-hat ma tu Ho, ra-mo-ti ma na-si-da; Ai na di au lu-hut-na na ni-le-hon-Mu do.
Pa-i-an su-ru-an-Mu tong-tong di lam-bung-kon,
Ai ing-kon ra-mo-tan-Mu do ton-ding-ki tong-tong;
Di-baen pa-ngong-gop ni si-bo-lis di ro-hang-ku, Ang-gi-at a-lo-on-ku mam-ba-hen do-sa i.
Mar-gu-ru tu Tu-han-ku ma au di sa-su-de;
Di-to-gu De-ba-tang-ku ma au tu na tu-re,
Sai pa-su-pa-su ma u-la-on ni ta-ngan-ku, Su-de si-ba-he-non-ku, o Tu-han De-ba-ta!
An-tong hu-dok ma a-men, ndang gang-gu ro-hang-ki!
Tu-han-ku ma-nga-le-hon na hu-pa-ngi-do i.
Na lao ma au nu-aeng ma-ngu-la u-la-on-ku; I-ba-na do do-ngan-ku na so-nang au di-baen

rows: Bin-sar ma ma-no-got on, o pa-non-dang ni Ja-ho-wa
Sai son-da-ngi ha-mi on, a-sa ba-li si-an ro-ha
Sa-su-de na ho-lom i, bae-non-Mi.

verses: Binsar ma manogot on, o panondang ni Jahowa,
Sai sondangi hami on, asa bali sian roha
Sasude na holom i, baenonMi.
Doshon nambur ma basaM manonggopi rohanami.
Asa asi ni rohaM, mamuati arsaknami;
Sai apoi siseanMon, hami on.
Dohot holong ni rohaM manungguli tondinami
Mangihuthon tu hataM lam holong ma rohanami
Mida Ho dohot sude jolma pe.
Mudar parpadanan i, i ma hatigorannami,
Asa roha dosa i pinabali sian hami.
Jala dao na bernit pe sasude.
Sondang sian surgo i binsar tu tanomannami.
Molo jumpang ariMi, asa hehe dagingnami,
Masuk tu halasan ni roha i.
Jesus, Ho panondang i, sai patiur langkanami
Sian partangisan i tu silas ni rohanami,
Jambar na manongtong di surgo i.
title: Binsar ma manogot on
status: Lirik dicek · 18/18 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Do-shon nam-bur ma ba-saM ma-nong-go-pi ro-ha-na-mi.
A-sa a-si ni ro-haM, ma-mu-a-ti ar-sak-na-mi;
Sai a-poi si-se-an-Mon, ha-mi on.
Do-hot ho-long ni ro-haM ma-nung-gu-li ton-di-na-mi
Ma-ngi-hut-hon tu ha-taM lam ho-long ma ro-ha-na-mi
Mi-da Ho do-hot su-de jol-ma pe.
Mu-dar par-pa-da-nan i, i ma ha-ti-go-ran-na-mi,
A-sa ro-ha do-sa i pi-na-ba-li si-an ha-mi.
Ja-la dao na ber-nit pe sa-su-de.
Son-dang si-an sur-go i bin-sar tu ta-no-man-na-mi.
Mo-lo jum-pang a-ri-Mi, a-sa he-he da-ging-na-mi,
Ma-suk tu ha-la-san ni ro-ha i.
Je-sus, Ho pa-non-dang i, sai pa-ti-ur lang-ka-na-mi
Si-an par-ta-ngi-san i tu si-las ni ro-ha-na-mi,
Jam-bar na ma-nong-tong di sur-go i.

rows: O Je-sus, son-dang ni Ja-ho-wa, A-ma-na-mi
Naung sal-pu bor-ngin i, ti-ur hu-i-da ha-mi
Tar-sung-gul do nu-aeng go-gong-ku sa-su-de, di-ba-hen i um-baen di Ho ma-lu-ngun i.

verses: O Jesus, sondang ni Jahowa, Amanami
Naung salpu borngin i, tiur huida hami
Tarsunggul do nuaeng gogongku sasude,
Dibahen i umbaen di Ho malungun i.
Tung aha di rohaM huboan peleanMu?
Tu asi ni rohaM hubonom ma rohangku?
Nang tondi daging pe manipat ari on;
I ma peleanMi na asing ndang adong.
Ipe, o Tuhanki sai jalo ma tondingku;
Ho ma mampuna i, padomu tu TondiMu.
Di holong ni rohaM di Ho ma rohangki,
Gomgoman ni hataM, baen hasangaponMi.
Nang pe parmatangkon hulehon ingananMu,
Tagan di tano on siparbadiaanMu.
O Jesus, Tuhanki rajai pangolu au;
Ai molo songon i, mardomu Ho tu au.
Uloshon, Jesuski tu au ma hatigoran,
Holong ni rohaMi dohot haporseaon.
Benget ni roha i, nang haiason pe,
Serep ni roha i na uli sasude.
Sai pasupasu ma sude pambahenanku,
O Tuhan Debata, nang nasa pingkiranku,
Sai naeng marsangap Ho dibaen hatangku pe,
Paboa na di Ho do gogongki sude.
title: Jahowa, Tuhanki
status: Lirik dicek · 20/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Tung a-ha di ro-haM hu-bo-an pe-le-an-Mu?
Tu a-si ni ro-haM hu-bo-nom ma ro-hang-ku?
Nang ton-di da-ging pe ma-ni-pat a-ri on; I ma pe-le-an-Mi na a-sing ndang a-dong.
I-pe, o Tu-han-ki sai ja-lo ma ton-ding-ku;
Ho ma mam-pu-na i, pa-do-mu tu Ton-di-Mu.
Di ho-long ni ro-haM di Ho ma ro-hang-ki, Gom-go-man ni ha-taM, baen ha-sa-nga-pon-Mi.
Nang pe par-ma-tang-kon hu-le-hon i-nga-nan-Mu,
Ta-gan di ta-no on si-par-ba-di-a-an-Mu.
O Je-sus, Tu-han-ki ra-jai pa-ngo-lu au; Ai mo-lo so-ngon i, mar-do-mu Ho tu au.
U-los-hon, Je-sus-ki tu au ma ha-ti-go-ran,
Ho-long ni ro-ha-Mi do-hot ha-por-se-a-on.
Ben-get ni ro-ha i, nang ha-i-a-son pe, Se-rep ni ro-ha i na u-li sa-su-de.
Sai pa-su-pa-su ma su-de pam-ba-he-nan-ku,
O Tu-han De-ba-ta, nang na-sa ping-ki-ran-ku,
Sai naeng mar-sa-ngap Ho di-baen ha-tang-ku pe, Pa-bo-a na di Ho do go-gong-ki su-de.

Gogo ni dagingku dipasuang Ho, siulahononku
Ari on naung ro, dohot do rohangku diramoti Ho;
Tiur do matangku manatapi Ho.
Jesus, pargogoi ma au sadari on, sai padao ma dosa
Sian rohangkon asa huithon hataMi tongtong,
Jala hupasanggap Ho di tano on

verses: Ale tondingku, hehe ma, dung salpu haholomon
Ai dipabinsar Debata muse panondang bolon
Pasohot ma na modom i, Ai ingkon pasangaponmi,
Tuhanta na di surgo.
Di hatiuron lao sude tumopot ulaonna;
Sogot do angka pidong pe pangiar soarana.
Tama do i tiruan ni saluhut manisia i,
Mamuji Debatana.
Tatopot ulaonta be, baen sangap di Tuhanta;
Sai hehe hita sasude, paboa las rohanta,
Mamangke hagogoon i, nilehon ni Tuhanta i,
Tu hita saluhutna
Marsorinsorin ari i sai tading do ulaon,
Urupi, Jesus hami be, mangalo haotoon
Paringgas hami on sude mamangke gogonami be,
Dibaen naung sinondangMu.
Torang baen rohanami, be, togu haporseaon.
Paserep rohanami pe, sai lehon roha holong
Tu nami, asa tung tanda naung dipatiur Debata,
Huhut disunggul hami.
O sondang salelengna i, sai mian di rohangku;
Di dalan hatigoran i papintor ma langkangku.
Pasahat au tu huta i, naung dipauli tanganMi,
Soada be na holom.

r: Di ha-ti-u-ron lao su-de tu-mo-pot u-la-on-na;
So-got do ang-ka pi-dong pe pa-ngi-ar so-a-ra-na.
Ta-ma do i ti-ru-an ni sa-lu-hut ma-ni-si-a i, Ma-mu-ji De-ba-ta-na.
Ta-to-pot u-la-on-ta be, baen sa-ngap di Tu-han-ta;
Sai he-he hi-ta sa-su-de, pa-bo-a las ro-han-ta,
Ma-mang-ke ha-go-go-on i, ni-le-hon ni Tu-han-ta i, Tu hi-ta sa-lu-hut-na
Mar-so-rin-so-rin a-ri i sai ta-ding do u-la-on,
U-ru-pi, Je-sus ha-mi be, ma-nga-lo ha-o-to-on
Pa-ring-gas ha-mi on su-de ma-mang-ke go-go-na-mi be, Di-baen naung si-non-dang-Mu.
To-rang baen ro-ha-na-mi, be, to-gu ha-por-se-a-on.
Pa-se-rep ro-ha-na-mi pe, sai le-hon ro-ha ho-long
Tu na-mi, a-sa tung tan-da naung di-pa-ti-ur De-ba-ta, Hu-hut di-sung-gul ha-mi.
O son-dang sa-le-leng-na i, sai mi-an di ro-hang-ku;
Di da-lan ha-ti-go-ran i pa-pin-tor ma lang-kang-ku.
Pa-sa-hat au tu hu-ta i, naung di-pa-u-li ta-ngan-Mi, So-a-da be na ho-lom.

rows: Hu-pu-ji Ho, a-le Tu-han-ku, ai born-gin i do di-pa-sal-pu Ho, a-sa tung-ti-ur mu-se por-ti-bi on, naung ni-ling-go-man ni ha-ra-ja-on ha-ho-lo-man; To-rang di-ba-hen Ho su-de.

verses: Hupuji Ho, ale Tuhanku, ai borngin i do dipasalpu
Ho, asa tungtiur muse portibi on, naung nilinggoman
ni harajaon haholoman; Torang dibahen Ho sude.
Sai hehe ho, ale tondingku, pelehon ma tu Debatamu
mauliate ni roham! Tandai ma denggan ni basaNa,
Na ganup sogot tinongosNa, girgir ma puji Debatam.
On do sinangkap ni rohangku, Tiur dibahen Debatangku
Na dibagasan rohangki, siman tu langit ma rohangku,
Jesusku, mata ni aringku baen sangap di Debatangki,
Anggiat bali,ale Tuhan, sude pambaenan haholoman
Sian rohangku dibaen Ho huhut imbaru pingkiranku
Dihorhon, Jesus, panondangmu, papintor langkangki tu Ho.
I ma nuaeng pangidoanku: Sai lehon i di au, Amangku,
Sai dok ma: Amen, saut ma i, antong, dung gok ariaringku,
Panondang! Ho ma topotonku; sonang ma au dilambungMi.

r: Sai he-he ho, a-le ton-ding-ku, pe-le-hon ma tu De-ba-ta-mu mau-li-a-te ni ro-ham! Tan-da-i ma deng-gan ni ba-sa-Na, Na ga-nup so-got ti-no-ngos-Na, gir-gir ma pu-ji De-ba-tam.
On do si-nang-kap ni ro-hang-ku, Ti-ur di-ba-hen De-ba-tang-ku Na di-ba-ga-san ro-hang-ki, si-man tu la-ngit ma ro-hang-ku, Je-sus-ku, ma-ta ni a-ring-ku baen sa-ngap di De-ba-tang-ki,
Ang-gi-at ba-li-,a-le Tu-han, su-de pam-ba-e-nan ha-ho-lo-man Sian ro-hang-ku di-baen Ho hu-hut im-ba-ru ping-ki-ran-ku Di-hor-hon, Je-sus, pa-non-dang-mu, pa-pin-tor lang-kang-ki tu Ho.
I ma nu-aeng pa-ngi-do-an-ku: Sai le-hon i di au, A-mang-ku, Sai dok ma: A-men, saut ma i, an-tong, dung gok a-ri-a-ring-ku, Pa-non-dang! Ho ma to-po-ton-ku; so-nang ma au di-lam-bung-Mi.

verses: Mata ni ari Binsar saonari
lao manondangi, lao manorangi, mangalaslasi sandok tano on.
Di podomanku naborngin badanku, hehe ma ahu nuaeng.
asa laho, asa huida tiur ari on.
Nasa na uli, na pinauli ni Debatangku,
Diida matangku na marmulia do Debatangki.
Laos na hutanda huhut na huida jambar na uli ni
Angka na muli sogot lambung ni Tuhanta i.
Sai taendehon ma hasangapon di Debatanta,
Jala rohanta sai tapelehon tu Tuhanta i.
I ma pelean na tongtong dumengggan,
Endeendenia do doshon daupa, lomo ni roha ni Tuhanta i.
Borngin, arian do sinarihon ni Debatanta,
Hasonanganta pinatupaNa sambing do tongtong.
Modom pe hita, disi do Ibana, hehe dagingta
Sogot manogotna, sai disondangi muse hita on.
Las ni rohanta sian Tuhanta, nang pe arsakta

Hangoluanta dilehon Tuhanta asal ditogu do hita tu surgo,
Ingkon manumpak tusi sasude.
Sai na marujung do haporsuhon dung salpu borngin,
Dung pur pe angin, sai na sumisi ma ombun sude.
Las ma rohanta dibahen Tuhanta di hasonangan di
Banua ginjang, ia dung sahat tusi hita be.

r: Na-sa na u-li, na pi-na-u-li ni De-ba-tang-ku, Di-i-da ma-tang-ku na mar-mu-li-a do De-ba-tang-ki. Laos na hu-tan-da hu-hut na hu-i-da jam-bar na u-li ni Ang-ka na mu-li so-got lam-bung ni Tu-han-ta i.

Sai ta-en-de-hon ma ha-sa-nga-pon di De-ba-tan-ta, Ja-la ro-han-ta sai ta-pe-le-hon tu Tu-han-ta i. I ma pe-le-an na tong-tong du-mengg-gan, En-deen-de-ni-a do do-shon da-u-pa, lo-mo ni ro-ha ni Tu-han-ta i.

Bor-ngin, a-ri-an do si-na-ri-hon ni De-ba-tan-ta, Ha-so-na-ngan-ta pi-na-tu-pa-Na sam-bing do tong-tong. Mo-dom pe hi-ta, di-si do I-ba-na, he-he da-ging-ta So-got ma-no-got-na, sai di-son-da-ngi mu-se hi-ta on.

Las ni ro-han-ta si-an Tu-han-ta, nang pe ar-sak-ta Do ti-no-ngos-Na, sai na ha-se-a do i sa-su-de. Ha-ngo-lu-an-ta di-le-hon Tu-han-ta a-sal di-to-gu do hi-ta tu sur-go, Ing-kon ma-num-pak tu-si sa-su-de.

Sai na mar-u-jung do ha-por-su-hon dung sal-pu bor-ngin, Dung pur pe a-ngin, sai na su-mi-si ma om-bun su-de. Las ma ro-han-ta di-ba-hen Tu-han-ta di ha-so-na-ngan di Ba-nu-a gin-jang, i-a dung sa-hat tu-si hi-ta be.

Sadari on urupi au mambaen na pinatikMu.
Pangolu au sadari on, Ho do pangkirimanku;
Padao ma jea i tongtong, sai sesa ma dosangku.
Papos rohangku mida Ho, gok holong baen rohangku;
Pistar ma au huhut gogo mambaen sibahenonku.
Sai luluanku na burju di au harajaonMu,
Porman nang tigor situtu ma baen pangalahongku.
Lao mangurupi dongan i, paringgas ma rohangku;
Manaek pangabahanNa i, las ma disi rohangku.
Marroha na bonar ma au tongtong di adopanMu:
Marlasniroha ma au lao, dung ro panjauM, Tuhanku!

Mar-ro-ha na bo-nar ma au tong-tong di a-do-pan-Mu: Mar-las-ni-ro-ha ma au lao, dung ro pan-jauM, Tu-han-ku!

rows: Nu-nga lo-ja da-ging-kon, Naeng ma pit-pit ma-tang-kon, o Tu-han-ku, ma-ta-Mi du-ngo di po-do-man-ki

verses: Nunga loja dagingkon, Naeng ma pitpit matangkon,
O Tuhanku, mataMi dungo di podomanki.
Sesa jolo sasude na hubaen na so ture;
Ai luhut na sala i dipature Hesuski.
Dohot angka donganki, sahat ma tu tanganMi.
Isi ni portibi on jaga ma saborngin on.
Angka na mardangol i dohot na marsahit i,
Angkup ni na tangis pe, sai apuli ma sude.
title: Nunga loja dagingkon
status: Lirik dicek · 7/8 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Se-sa jo-lo sa-su-de na hu-baen na so tu-re; Ai lu-hut na sa-la i di-pa-tu-re He-sus-ki.
Do-hot ang-ka do-ngan-ki, sa-hat ma tu ta-ngan-Mi. I-si ni por-ti-bi on ja-ga ma sa-bor-ngin on.
Ang-ka na mar-da-ngol i do-hot na mar-sa-hit i, Ang-kup ni na ta-ngis pe, sai a-pu-li ma su-de.

rows: Tung so-nang mo-dom a-hu sa-bor-ngin on,
So jo-lo Ho, Tu-han-ku, i-ngo-ton-kon
Na mam-par do ro-hang-ku na-ri-an i: tu Ho ma lu-lu-an-ku na so-nang i,

verses: Tung sonang modom ahu saborngin on,
So jolo Ho, Tuhanku, ingotonkon
Na mampar do rohangku narian i: tu Ho ma luluanku na sonang i,
Sai sesa nasa dosa, ale Amang! Ho, na marholong roha,
Asi rohaM! Paias ma rohangku na ranum i;
Pagirgir au, mamuji Ho, Tuhanki!
Urupi au, maniru panesaMi, nang pepangkaholongi ni rohaMi.
Na sonang ma au modom saborngin on,
Ai dame do maringan di rohangkon
title: Sai tiop ma tanganku
status: Lirik dicek · 7/9 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai se-sa na-sa do-sa, a-le A-mang!
Ho, na mar-ho-long ro-ha, A-si ro-haM!
Pa-i-as ma ro-hang-ku na ra-num i; Pa-gir-gir au, ma-mu-ji Ho, Tu-han-ki!
U-ru-pi au, ma-ni-ru pa-ne-sa-Mi,
nang pe-pang-ka-ho-lo-ngi ni ro-ha-Mi.
Na so-nang ma au mo-dom sa-bor-ngin on, Ai da-me do ma-ri-ngan di ro-hang-kon

rows: Ma-po-rus do a-ri-an,
Ma sal-pu ha-ti-u-ron.
Di-so-luk ha-ho-lo-mon, mam-baen pa-ra-di-a-nan di na-sa jol-ma i. Ho-lom do di ma-tang-ku, tu Ho do lao ro-hang-ku, si-tom-pa par-so-ri-nan, Ni an-ri do-hot bor-ngin, ma-mu-ji go-ar-Mi.

verses: Maporus do arian, Ma salpu hatiuron.
Disoluk haholomon, mambaen paradianan di nasa jolma i.
Holom do di matangku, tu Ho do lao rohangku,
Sitompa parsorinan, Ni anri dohot borngin,
Mamuji goarMi.
Girgir ma ho, tondingku, mamuji Debatamu,
Ai na so habilangan do saluhut na denggan, binaenNa i tu ho.
Satongkin pe ndang salpu, so sahat tu tanganmu
Godang denggan basaNa, nang asi ni rohaNa, na pangoluhon ho.
Ai songon siparmahan manjaga di adaran
Dorbia, asa dapot saluhut i na ringkot hangoluanna i;
Laos songon i Tuhanku, dilehon do bohalhu;
Tongtong do jinagaNa au songon dorbiaNa,
Dibaheni basaNa i.
Ndang au tinadingkonNa, hape pinatikkonNa
Jotjot nilaosanku, sai lilu do rohangku mambahen dosa i.
Asi rohaM, Amangku, paombun marimasMu;
Tama di au toruan, alai na huarsakkon
Sude pambaenanki.
Tangihon ma hatangku; sai sesa ma dosangku,
Ai mudar ni AnakMu, i do paridianku, na paiashon au
Sai dokko suruanMu, marsaro di lambungku;
Ho ma tongtongdonganku di na lao nok matangku.
Nang di na hehe au.
I ma na hina posan ni rohangkon, o Tuhan,
Umbaen sonang rohangku tumopot podomanku,
So humasusa au. Ai ndang habiaranku
Pangago ni musungku, dibaen habongkabongMu,
Namangkuphupi au, mangaramoti au.
Na modom manang dungo, na hundul manang laho.
Di tanganMi do ahu, Ho do hangoluanku; sintong do hata i.
Ai Ho do, pangondingan arian dohot borngin,
partanobatoanku, na so tadingkononku;
Ai sonang au disi.
title: Maporus do arian
status: Lirik dicek · 23/34 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Gir-gir ma ho, ton-ding-ku,
ma-mu-ji De-ba-ta-mu,
Ai na so ha-bi-la-ngan do sa-lu-hut na deng-gan, bi-naen-Na i tu ho. Sa-tong-kin pe ndang sal-pu, so sa-hat tu ta-ngan-mu Go-dang deng-gan ba-sa-Na, nang a-si ni ro-ha-Na, na pa-ngo-lu-hon ho.
Ai so-ngon si-par-ma-han
man-ja-ga di a-da-ran
Dor-bia, a-sa da-pot sa-lu-hut i na ring-kot ha-ngo-luan-na i; Laos so-ngon i Tu-han-ku, di-le-hon do bo-hal-hu; Tong-tong do ji-na-ga-Na au so-ngon dor-bi-a-Na, Di-ba-he-ni ba-sa-Na i.
Ndang au ti-na-ding-kon-Na,
ha-pe pi-na-tik-kon-Na
Jot-jot ni-lao-san-ku, sai li-lu do ro-hang-ku mam-ba-hen do-sa i. A-si ro-haM, A-mang-ku, pa-om-bun ma-ri-mas-Mu; Ta-ma di au to-ru-an, a-lai na hu-ar-sak-kon Su-de pam-ba-e-nan-ki.
Ta-ngi-hon ma ha-tang-ku;
sai se-sa ma do-sang-ku,
Ai mu-dar ni A-nak-Mu, i do pa-ri-di-an-ku, na pa-i-as-hon au Sai dok-ko su-ru-an-Mu, mar-sa-ro di lam-bung-ku; Ho ma tong-tong-do-ngan-ku di na lao nok ma-tang-ku. Nang di na he-he au.
I ma na hi-na po-san
ni ro-hang-kon, o Tu-han,
Um-baen so-nang ro-hang-ku tu-mo-pot po-do-man-ku, So hu-ma-su-sa au. Ai ndang ha-bi-a-ran-ku Pa-nga-go ni mu-sung-ku, di-ba-en ha-bong-ka-bong-Mu, Na-mang-kup-hu-pi au, ma-nga-ra-mo-ti au.
Na mo-dom ma-nang du-ngo,
na hun-dul ma-nang la-ho.
Di ta-ngan-Mi do a-hu, Ho do ha-ngo-lu-an-ku; sin-tong do ha-ta i. Ai Ho do, pa-ngon-di-ngan a-ri-an do-hot bor-ngin, par-ta-no-ba-to-an-ku, na so ta-ding-ko-non-ku; Ai so-nang au di-si.
